title: Agenda
description: An agenda entity as published in PublicGame.agendas (Arkham.Agenda.Types.AgendaAttrs). Doom-remover-matcher and card-union payloads remain intentionally broad.

agendaSequenceSide.description: Arkham.Agenda.Sequence.AgendaSide (Agenda/Sequence.hs), nullary-only so aeson's allNullaryToStringTag applies and it encodes as a bare string tag.

cardsUnderneath.description: Cards physically stacked underneath this agenda. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

modifiers.description: Active modifiers targeting this agenda. Broad and additive, out of scope for this contract slice.

removeDoomMatchers.description: The act/agenda matchers governing where a doom removal effect applies. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

tokens.description: A Token-keyed multiset, encoded as an array of [tokenName, count] pairs.

treacheries.description: TreacheryId (UUID) values attached to this agenda.
